title: MailMask
description: A per-site address on OpenVibe.Mail that delivers into its owner's OpenVibe mailbox and nowhere else. Turning it off makes the address bounce: it leaves the SQL directory Stalwart reads, so a new message is refused. The address is <words>.<four characters>@<mask domain>; the four characters keep two people from guessing each other's mask. The contract is metadata only: it never carries a message body.

id.description: The mask id. Opaque outside OpenVibe.Mail; never a database integer.

owner.description: The Network subject id of the person whose mailbox receives the mask's mail. A mask never forwards outside OpenVibe.

address.description: The mask address: the words the person chose, a dot, four unguessable characters, and the mask domain (mask.openvibe.email in M1).

label.description: The person's name for the mask, e.g. "Amazon". Free text; never interpreted as an address.

purpose.description: What the mask is for, e.g. "shopping". Optional metadata for the person's own list.

enabled.description: Whether the mask resolves. When false the SQL directory has no row for the address, so the mail server refuses it.

created_at.description: When the mask was made, ISO 8601 UTC.
